# Godot editor icons

The SVG files in `editor/icons/` are Godot Engine's editor icons, copied
unchanged from Godot **4.7.2-stable**
(commit `ed1daf0bf001b61586d9930840f2f1394092c079`, folder `editor/icons`).

They are MIT-licensed; see `LICENSE.txt`. Copyright (c) 2014-present Godot
Engine contributors, (c) 2007-2014 Juan Linietsky, Ariel Manzur.

Oddity Engine is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Godot Engine project.
"Godot" and the Godot logo are trademarks of the Godot Foundation and are not
used for Oddity branding.

To update: copy `editor/icons/*.svg` from a newer Godot tag, update the
version above, and run `cargo test -p oddity_icons`.
